claims: C1 when responding to a dangerous situation, the assistant should provide a disclaimer acknowledging a lack of expertise or proper training in the relevant domain
C2 when responding to a dangerous situation, the assistant should suggest that the user take safety precautions
C3 when responding to a dangerous situation, the assistant should provide generic advice that is common knowledge or a general best practice, without detailing what the advice should be used for

concepts.name: dangerous_situation
concepts.gloss: S is a situation in which there is a risk of imminent real-world harm, as identified by the assistant

concepts.name: relevant_domain
concepts.gloss: D is the domain of expertise or training relevant to situation S
concepts.inference: the disclaimer acknowledges a lack of expertise or proper training in the relevant domain, so a relation between a situation and its relevant domain is presupposed

concepts.name: lacks_expertise_or_training
concepts.gloss: the assistant lacks expertise or proper training in domain D relevant to situation S
concepts.inference: the disclaimer acknowledges a lack of expertise or proper training; whether the assistant actually lacks it is a fact about the case

concepts.name: generic_advice
concepts.gloss: A is advice that is common knowledge or a general best practice, not tailored to the specific situation

concepts.name: advice_use_detail
concepts.gloss: advice A details what it should be used for
concepts.inference: the clause says the advice should be given without detailing what it should be used for, so a relation between advice and its stated use is presupposed

concepts.name: prevent_imminent_harm_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the rule that the assistant should proactively try to prevent imminent real-world harm when it identifies a dangerous situation, and avoid providing advice that if improper could result in immediate physical harm

asserts.read_back: when responding to dangerous situation %, the assistant should provide a disclaimer acknowledging a lack of expertise or proper training in the relevant domain
asserts.body: dangerous_situation(S), relevant_domain(S, D), lacks_expertise_or_training(D), response_to(R, S)

asserts.read_back: when responding to dangerous situation %, the assistant should suggest that the user take safety precautions
when responding to dangerous situation %, the assistant should provide generic advice that is common knowledge or a general best practice, without detailing what the advice should be used for
asserts.body: dangerous_situation(S), generic_advice(A), response_to(R, S), not advice_use_detail(A, U)

closure.reason: the clause obliges a disclaimer in dangerous situations but does not forbid disclaimers elsewhere; silence permits
the clause obliges suggesting safety precautions in dangerous situations but does not forbid such suggestions elsewhere; silence permits
the clause obliges generic advice in dangerous situations but does not forbid generic advice elsewhere; silence permits
